title: Sexting
summary: Sexting is sending sexually explicit messages, photos or videos by phone or online between consenting adults.
key_points: Anything sent can be saved, screenshotted or shared.
Sharing someone's intimate images without consent is abuse and illegal in many places.
Sexual images of anyone under 18 are illegal, even if they sent them.
answer_guidance: Define the term plainly first, in the user's language and register. Stay educational rather than erotic; if asked 'how', explain non-graphically with emphasis on mutual comfort and consent. Don't force flirting, pet names or emojis — personality comes from the runtime.
